provider: A Stock AI Research System 5.0 API
schema:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: A Stock AI Research System 5.0 API
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: >
    Dify Custom Tool schema for the external Python core. All write operations
    are simulation-only and require bearer authentication.
servers:
  - url: https://a-stock-system.onrender.com
    description: Replace with the HTTPS URL of your deployed Python service.
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      operationId: health
      summary: Check service health and provider configuration.
      security: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Service status.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/HealthResponse"
  /pipeline/run:
    post:
      operationId: runPipeline
      summary: Run the full 9-Agent daily pipeline for a date.
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                date:
                  type: string
                  description: YYYY-MM-DD or today.
                  default: today
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Pipeline result.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
  /reports/daily/{date}:
    get:
      operationId: getDailyReport
      summary: Get the daily report for one trading date.
      parameters:
        - name: date
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          description: YYYY-MM-DD.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Daily report JSON.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/DailyReport"
  /market-state/{date}:
    get:
      operationId: getMarketState
      summary: Get Signal Agent's 7-dimensional market state.
      parameters:
        - name: date
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Market state.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/MarketState"
  /candidates:
    get:
      operationId: getCandidates
      summary: Get PM Agent candidates.
      parameters:
        - name: date
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            default: today
        - name: min_ev
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: number
            default: 8
        - name: risk_allowed
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            default: A,B
          description: Comma-separated risk grades.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Candidate list.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  run_date:
                    type: string
                  candidates:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/PMCandidate"
  /decisions/approve:
    post:
      operationId: approveDecision
      summary: Approve or reject one PM candidate in the simulation account.
      description: This never sends a real order. Approval creates a simulated trade only.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [date, symbol, approved]
              properties:
                date:
                  type: string
                  description: YYYY-MM-DD or today.
                symbol:
                  type: string
                approved:
                  type: boolean
                approved_by:
                  type: string
                  default: dify_pm_console
                reason:
                  type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Decision and simulated execution result.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
  /trades/exit:
    post:
      operationId: exitTrade
      summary: Close one simulated trade and record the exit reason.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [exit_price, exit_reason]
              properties:
                trade_id:
                  type: integer
                symbol:
                  type: string
                exit_date:
                  type: string
                  default: today
                exit_price:
                  type: number
                exit_reason:
                  type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Closed trade result.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
  /review:
    get:
      operationId: getReview
      summary: Get recent Review Agent reports.
      parameters:
        - name: period
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            default: all_closed_trades
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Review reports.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
  /guard/status:
    get:
      operationId: getGuardStatus
      summary: Run or get Guard Agent status.
      parameters:
        - name: date
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            default: today
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Guard status.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
  /watchlist:
    post:
      operationId: upsertWatchlistItem
      summary: Add or update one watchlist item.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [item]
              properties:
                item:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/WatchlistItem"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Updated watchlist status.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
  /research/run:
    post:
      operationId: runResearch
      summary: Re-run Research Agent for a date.
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                date:
                  type: string
                  default: today
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Research result.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
  /hermes/observe:
    post:
      operationId: hermesObserve
      summary: Ask local Hermes Agent to produce a non-decision context observation.
      description: >
        Optional local bridge. Hermes output is supplemental context only and never replaces
        PM/Risk/Guard decisions. Disabled unless A_STOCK_ENABLE_HERMES_BRIDGE=true.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [prompt]
              properties:
                prompt:
                  type: string
                  description: Text, screenshot OCR, notes, or user context to summarize.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Hermes supplemental observation, disabled status, or unavailable status.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: A_STOCK_API_KEY
  schemas:
    HealthResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
        service:
          type: string
        mode:
          type: string
        auth_configured:
          type: boolean
        deepseek_configured:
          type: boolean
    SignalVector:
      type: object
      properties:
        emotion:
          type: number
        theme_momentum:
          type: number
        institution_flow:
          type: number
        quant_dominance:
          type: number
        liquidity:
          type: number
        chaos:
          type: number
        narrative_heat:
          type: number
    MarketState:
      type: object
      properties:
        run_date:
          type: string
        signal_vector:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/SignalVector"
        max_position_pct:
          type: number
        force_cash_reasons:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
    Scenario:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        expected_return_pct:
          type: number
        probability:
          type: number
        invalidation_condition:
          type: string
    PMCandidate:
      type: object
      properties:
        symbol:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        action:
          type: string
        composite_score:
          type: number
        alpha_score:
          type: number
        risk_grade:
          type: string
        scenario_tree:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Scenario"
        ev_pct:
          type: number
        proposed_position_pct:
          type: number
        stop_loss_condition:
          type: string
        approved:
          type: boolean
    DailyReport:
      type: object
      properties:
        run_date:
          type: string
        market_state:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/SignalVector"
        max_position_pct:
          type: number
        pm_plan:
          type: object
        open_sim_trades:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
        guard_alerts:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
        disclaimer:
          type: string
    WatchlistItem:
      type: object
      required: [symbol, name]
      properties:
        symbol:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        industry:
          type: string
        theme:
          type: string
        market_cap_bucket:
          type: string
          enum: [small, mid, large]
        is_follower:
          type: boolean
custom_disclaimer: 仅供学习研究、模拟盘和纪律辅助使用，不构成投资建议，不连接真实下单。
